text: Empirically, for ConvNet-3 on CIFAR-10 and ResNet-10 on ImageNet-10 the dense initialization is unstable, i.e., trained models land in different minima.

When using Efficient Dataset Condensation tuned for the target architecture and of appropriate quality for the target model, Distilled Pruning matches the test accuracy of traditional IMP on ResNet-18 trained on CIFAR-10.
On CIFAR-100 or larger datasets with poorer distilled accuracy, synthetic subnetworks tend to be more stable than traditional IMP.
